paper_title: Novel Constraints on Axions Produced in Pulsar Polar-Cap Cascades
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1 (approximate, read from Fig. 2 range)
notes: Paper derives 95% CL upper limits on axion-photon coupling g_aγγ from radio observations of 27 nearby pulsars, using axion production in neutron star polar-cap vacuum gaps (NOT assuming axions are dark matter, so no DM density assumption). Valid for masses 1e-8 to 1e-5 eV. Constraints are order ~1e-11 GeV^-1, with example calculations using g_aγγ ~ 1e-11 GeV^-1. Exact limit values are in Fig. 2/S6 which are not machine-readable in this text; data points are approximate estimates spanning the stated mass range. No numerical exclusion table is provided in the text, so extraction confidence is low for the precise coupling values. | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 3, 0, 0.4, 4))
